plainTranslation: Person B (Mars)'s willingness to begin can complement Person A (Saturn)'s patience and ability to sustain an effort. Person A (Saturn) can respond to initiative with practical commitment, while Person B (Mars) can encourage Person A (Saturn) to use preparation rather than keep it separate from action. Each may come to appreciate a capacity that the other contributes: readiness to act or willingness to continue when effort is required. The sextile offers a way for assertion and restraint to cooperate when both people participate. A shared undertaking can express this, but is not required as the subject of the relationship. The contact does not assign permanent authority to Person A (Saturn) or make reliability a promise of affection or longevity.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that caution can quietly turn into avoidance. You may find yourself endlessly preparing, analyzing, or addressing one concern after another until you lose touch with the original goal. On the other side, you may dismiss their input before fully considering it because receiving guidance feels uncomfortable or limiting.
advice: Discipline is useful when it helps you move forward. It is a problem when it becomes an excuse to do nothing.
summaryShort: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
